Bug Title & Summary: WhatsApp Analytics page is 100% static mock data with zero database connection or API calls
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /admin/whatsapp/analytics. 2. Inspect Network tab. 3. Query PostgreSQL wa_conversation.
Expected Behavior: Metrics must be computed from real DB records (total conversations, delivered, read, SLA time) via an authenticated API endpoint.
Actual Behavior: The page calls zero APIs; all 4 KPI cards and resolution bars are statically hardcoded mock objects.
Proposed Developer Fix: Implement GET /api/v1/WhatsApp/Analytics in backend and connect frontend with dynamic state and IST date range filters.

Bug Title & Summary: Human agent takeover switch in Live Chat does not persist to database; AI bot continues replying
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open live chat. 2. Toggle AI switch from 'AI' to manual mode. 3. Send test message from candidate phone.
Expected Behavior: Switching to manual agent mode must send PATCH to update conversation_status to 'human_takeover', pausing the bot.
Actual Behavior: aiEnabled state is held purely in React useState; no API is called; backend sees conversation_status as 'open' and continues replying.
Proposed Developer Fix: Create PATCH /api/v1/WhatsApp/Conversations/:id/takeover endpoint and wire Switch onCheckedChange to update DB state.

Bug Title & Summary: Candidate experience, CTC, and notice period regex extraction is skipped on first incoming message
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send WhatsApp message from new number: 'Backend Developer in Chennai. 4 years exp, serving notice, expected CTC 10 LPA'. 2. Inspect lead table in DB.
Expected Behavior: New candidate record should immediately extract total_experience=4, expected_ctc=10, employment_status='Serving Notice'.
Actual Behavior: Field extraction regexes are located inside the 'else' block (lines 205-260) and omitted when creating a brand new lead (lines 178-193).
Proposed Developer Fix: Move candidate profile extraction logic into a shared helper function executed for both new and existing leads.

Bug Title & Summary: Campaign creation lacks template variable parameter mapping, causing Meta Cloud API errors
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open /admin/whatsapp/campaigns. 2. Create campaign with template having {{1}} and {{2}}. 3. Launch campaign.
Expected Behavior: UI should prompt mapping for each variable (e.g. {{1}} -> Lead Name, {{2}} -> Job Role) and backend must pass template components with parameters.
Actual Behavior: Dialog only collects template_name; backend sends raw string without template parameters, causing Meta error 132000.
Proposed Developer Fix: Add variable mapping input in dialog and build template component parameter array in campaign execution.

Bug Title & Summary: Customer phone number rendered with double plus signs '++919840199999'
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open /admin/whatsapp. 2. Look at conversation list and active chat header phone display.
Expected Behavior: Phone numbers should format cleanly with a single '+' (e.g. '+91 98401 99999').
Actual Behavior: Template literal unconditionally prepends '+': `+{conv.customer_phone}`, producing '++' when phone already starts with '+'.
Proposed Developer Fix: Format phone using a helper: `phone.startsWith('+') ? phone : `+${phone}`.

Bug Title & Summary: Message timestamps formatted without explicit Indian Standard Time (IST) timezone and IST label
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open live chat. 2. Change computer timezone to GMT or US Eastern. 3. Observe message timestamps.
Expected Behavior: Timestamps must render in Indian Standard Time with explicit 'IST' label (e.g. '10:41 AM IST').
Actual Behavior: formatMessageTime uses toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) with no timezone specified.
Proposed Developer Fix: Pass { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' } and append ' IST' to formatted time.

Bug Title & Summary: Outbound AI bot messages include unsolicited emojis violating zero-emoji policy
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send inquiry to connected WhatsApp number. 2. Inspect outbound reply in DB.
Expected Behavior: Replies must contain zero emojis by default; at most one in final booking confirmation if needed.
Actual Behavior: Prompt presets and system prompts include emojis ('👋', '🎉', '🚀') without an output sanitization filter.
Proposed Developer Fix: Add emoji stripper / output filter in WhatsAppWebhookService before sending outbound messages.

Bug Title & Summary: Chat composer uses single-line text input, preventing multi-line messages with Shift+Enter
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to Live Chat composer. 2. Type text and press Shift+Enter.
Expected Behavior: Should insert a newline and allow multi-line paragraph formatting.
Actual Behavior: Element is a standard `<input type='text'>` which cannot create newlines.
Proposed Developer Fix: Replace <input> with auto-resizing <textarea> supporting Enter to submit and Shift+Enter for newline.

Bug Title & Summary: Emoji picker and file attachment buttons are dead non-functional icons
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Click Smile icon in live chat composer. 2. Click Paperclip icon.
Expected Behavior: Smile icon should toggle emoji picker popover; paperclip should trigger file upload input.
Actual Behavior: Buttons have no onClick listeners or file input elements associated with them.
Proposed Developer Fix: Implement native file upload dialog with PDF/image validation and emoji popover.

Bug Title & Summary: Media, PDF resumes, and voice notes render as raw fallback strings without preview or download
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Candidate uploads PDF resume. 2. Open chat thread in Live Chat.
Expected Behavior: Should display PDF icon with filename, file size, and download button; audio should show waveform/player.
Actual Behavior: Message bubble directly renders `{msg.message_text}` with zero media component handling.
Proposed Developer Fix: Add media component rendering for document (PDF preview/download), image (lightbox), and audio (HTML5 player).

Bug Title & Summary: Bot re-asks candidate for full name even when candidate profile name is already known
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Inbound message from candidate with profile name 'Karthik Raja'. 2. Observe bot response.
Expected Behavior: Bot should greet candidate by name and not re-ask: 'Could you please share your full name?'.
Actual Behavior: Prompt engine does not instruct LLM to treat Meta profile name as already collected.
Proposed Developer Fix: Inject clear prompt instruction: 'Candidate full name is already known as {name}; never re-ask for full name.'

Bug Title & Summary: Bot asks multiple distinct questions in a single response, violating the one-question-per-message rule
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send inquiry about job role. 2. Inspect bot reply.
Expected Behavior: Bot must ask exactly ONE question per message (e.g. ask for resume first, then availability).
Actual Behavior: Bot replied with: 'Could you please share your full name and an updated resume? Also, are you comfortable with Hybrid in Chennai?'.
Proposed Developer Fix: Enforce strict system instruction and post-processing verification for single question replies.

Bug Title & Summary: Deprecated title 'WhatsApp Automation Suite' still rendered in tab header
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /admin/whatsapp/campaigns, /templates, or /brain. 2. Look at page title.
Expected Behavior: Title must read 'WhatsApp Automation' with zero occurrences of 'Suite'.
Actual Behavior: Ternary operator defaults to 'WhatsApp Automation Suite' on line 87.
Proposed Developer Fix: Change 'WhatsApp Automation Suite' to 'WhatsApp Automation'.

Bug Title & Summary: whatsappService returns fake demo templates and mock conversation on API error
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Stop backend. 2. Navigate to /admin/whatsapp/templates. 3. Observe template list.
Expected Behavior: UI should display an Error State banner with retry button.
Actual Behavior: Catch blocks return hardcoded mock data: 'interview_invitation_v1' and 'Rajesh Kumar'.
Proposed Developer Fix: Remove fake mock fallbacks in service catch blocks; propagate errors so UI displays proper error banner.

Bug Title & Summary: Campaign loop lacks rate limiting and opt-out checking, risking Meta API suspension
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Launch broadcast to recipient list. 2. Check dispatch loop.
Expected Behavior: Must throttle dispatches according to Meta tier limits (e.g. 50/sec) and exclude unsubscribed numbers.
Actual Behavior: for loop fires rapid synchronous requests with no delay and no check against wa_ai_config.stop_words.
Proposed Developer Fix: Implement throttled queue and query opted-out status before sending.

Bug Title & Summary: Template editor phone preview hardcodes recipient name 'Rahul Sharma' and brochure topic
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Template Editor. 2. Look at live phone mockup preview on right.
Expected Behavior: Variables should preview configurable sample values or generic placeholders.
Actual Behavior: Lines 93-94 hardcode replace {{1}} with 'Rahul Sharma' and {{2}} with 'Product Brochure & Quote'.
Proposed Developer Fix: Provide sample value inputs for each detected variable in the preview panel.

Bug Title & Summary: AI Brain page lacks interactive test chat playground sandbox
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /admin/whatsapp/brain. 2. Look for way to test newly saved prompts.
Expected Behavior: Should have an inline simulator chat pane to test prompt behavior immediately.
Actual Behavior: Page only contains form configuration cards without any test chat interface.
Proposed Developer Fix: Add interactive simulator sandbox panel with reset button and latency indicators.

Bug Title & Summary: Contact context panel accordion sections (About, Notes, Activity) are empty dummy shells
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open live chat contact details panel. 2. Click About, Notes, or Activity accordions.
Expected Behavior: Should expand to show candidate background, CRM notes history, and call/email touchpoints.
Actual Behavior: Cards render static chevron icons with no expandable content or onClick handlers.
Proposed Developer Fix: Connect accordions to real CRM lead activity and note records.

Bug Title & Summary: Recipients textarea in WhatsAppCampaignFormPage accepts any string with length > 5
Steps to Reproduce: 1. In Broadcast Recipients field, type 'random-text, 123456'. 2. Click Launch Broadcast.
Expected Behavior: Inline validator should flag invalid phone numbers and require country codes (+91...).
Actual Behavior: Only filters `p.length > 5`, allowing non-numeric and unroutable inputs.
Proposed Developer Fix: Add regex phone validation `^\+?[1-9]\d{9,14}$` with valid/invalid recipient badge counters.

Bug Title & Summary: Diagnostics modal log stream initializes with static fake log entries
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Click 'Diagnostics & Health' in topbar. 2. Observe initial logs.
Expected Behavior: Logs should come from live database table audit_log or error_log.
Actual Behavior: State initializes with hardcoded mock log objects on lines 52-60.
Proposed Developer Fix: Fetch recent webhook audit records via GET /api/v1/WhatsApp/SyncDiagnostics.
